jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

**Help define and advance the future of learning through Microsoft Viva Learning - enabling thousands of employees to build skills every day, in the flow of work.

We’re looking for a Learning & Development Product Consultant to lead key aspects of the firmwide deployment of Microsoft Viva Learning and help drive the end-to-end success of the platform. Working as a trusted partner to the Global Learning & Development Product Owner, senior Talent leaders, functional leads and regional teams, you will help shape strategic priorities, translate them into a practical roadmap, drive adoption at scale and deliver a modern, personalized learning experience aligned to business priorities.

As a global product consultant, you will sit at the heart of Talent, bringing together L&D, Technology and regional stakeholders to transform how learning is curated, delivered and experienced across the firm.

**In this role, you will:

**

• Partner with the Global L&D Product Owner and functional leads to set direction, align priorities and advance Microsoft Viva Learning as a global learning platform

• Translate strategy into a clear roadmap, practical governance and measurable success outcomes

• Drive adoption, engagement and measurable business impact across a complex global stakeholder landscape

• Use data, insights and stakeholder feedback to inform decisions, optimise performance and improve the learner experience

**What will help you succeed:

**

• Proven experience in product ownership, platform leadership or digital product delivery

• Strong background in Talent, Learning & Development or HR transformation

• Hands-on experience with Learning Experience Platforms, Microsoft Viva Learning or the Microsoft 365 ecosystem

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity and lead change in a complex global environment

This is a standout opportunity to help build a skills-led, experience-driven Talent ecosystem, powered by Microsoft Viva Learning — at global scale.

If you’re passionate about learning, product thinking and digital employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.

What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

• Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders

• Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting

• Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications

• Maintaining technical product information and documentation

• Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.

• Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support

• Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly

• Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Job Description

**If you want to take a leading role in shaping the IRB model landscape at a major Nordic bank, this is your opportunity. As Chief Data Scientist in our Risk Modelling and Analytics department, you will own complex modelling topics and help colleagues grow. You will work on models that matter, directly contributing to how Danske Bank manages credit risk.

**What you will be doing:

**You will join the LGD and CF development team within Risk Modelling and Analytics, a collaborative group that works across the full model development lifecycle. The team covers everything from understanding regulatory and business requirements and designing methodologies, through data sourcing and analysis, to building robust model solutions and supporting implementation, validation, and ongoing performance assessment. You will work closely with colleagues in Risk Management, Validation, IT and data teams, and the wider business, contributing to a culture where technical depth and clear thinking go hand in hand.

**More specifically, you will:

**

• Lead end-to-end development of IRB LGD and CF models, from data exploration to documentation.

• Take ownership of complex modelling challenges and contribute to key methodological decisions.

• Build robust, explainable, and regulatory-compliant models using statistical and machine learning techniques.

• Act as a technical sparring partner, sharing knowledge and supporting other Data Scientists.

• Contribute to regulatory dialogue and improve IRB modelling standards and practices.

**About you:

**

• Around five or more years of experience in data science, credit risk, or IRB model development.

• Strong experience in IRB model development, ideally including LGD and/or CF models.

• Skilled in writing clean, modular Python and SQL with good software engineering habits.

• Clear communicator, able to translate technical and mathematical concepts for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative and self-directed, comfortable taking ownership and sharing knowledge.

If you are curious about tools such as GitHub Copilot or AI-assisted coding, that is a genuine advantage. We value an open mindset and a willingness to explore smarter ways of working over prior experience with any specific tool.

**We offer:

**The workplace can be in Vilnius, Lithuania or Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are hired in Lithuania, monthly salary range would be from 4320 EUR to 6480 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (this one is only valid for Lithuania) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a DevOps & Platform Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in building, operating, and continuously enhancing the platforms and services that drive product development, testing, validation, deployment, and operations within Siemens Gamesa’s digital ecosystem. Imagine developing automation solutions, enhancing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with software teams to elevate the developer experience and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product development, validation, architecture, and infrastructure teams to ensure that our platforms remain reliable, secure, and scalable. Whether you are modernizing platform services or contributing to cloud-enabled solutions, your efforts will significantly accelerate how engineering teams deliver innovative solutions. Become part of an international team that values ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing in a culture driven by a strong engineering mindset.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop automation solutions that enhance reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, performance analysis, and service reliability practices.

• A proactive mindset with a passion for automation, continuous learning, and building reliable platform services.

Nice to Have

• Experience in Agile environments using Scrum or SAFe methodologies, along with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows.

• Familiarity with platform modernization, self-service platforms, developer experience initiatives, or Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Experience supporting engineering applications, industrial systems, SCADA environments, or operational technology solutions.

About the Team

You will join the Infrastructure Performance & Operations (IPO) team within Digital Products & Solutions. This team is dedicated to developing, operating, and evolving the digital platforms that support product engineering, validation, testing, and business operations across Siemens Gamesa. Our focus areas include platform engineering, automation, virtualization, CI/CD, observability, service reliability, infrastructure modernization, and operational excellence. Working in an Agile environment, we utilize Scrum and SAFe practices, ensuring alignment across development, infrastructure, architecture, validation, and product organizations. As our digital landscape evolves, the team is also shaping future platform capabilities, cloud adoption opportunities, and next-generation Digital Foundation services. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and engineers who thrive on solving complex challenges through code, automation, and modern platform engineering practices.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• How we evaluate AI quality.

• The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

**Must-haves

**

• You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

**Nice To Have (none Of Them Required)

**

• MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• Kubernetes

• Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

**About Dalea

**Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• Warrants: under the Danish

• 7P scheme

• Pension: through ASE

• Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• Language: English

• Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

We're also hiring a Senior AI Engineer. You're welcome to apply for more than one.

Would you like to contribute to ensuring high-quality pharmaceutical production while helping us simplify and improve the way we work? Do you have a strong quality mindset, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to adapt in a changing environment?

Then this may be the opportunity for you to join API Quality M3 in Kalundborg.

Our department provides quality assurance support to six purification facilities. You will become part of a collaborative department with a strong team spirit and highly skilled, ambitious and engaged colleagues. We place great emphasis on teamwork, adaptability and continuous personal and professional development.

We are looking for an experienced QA professional who combines strong quality awareness with curiosity and an improvement mindset. You should be motivated by working in a dynamic environment where priorities and business needs may change, and where we work together to find simple, robust and compliant solutions.

Your new role

You will join one of our two QA teams responsible for supporting daily operations and projects across three purification facilities.

Your main responsibility will be to provide proactive and risk-based QA oversight of processes and documentation related to daily production. Your tasks will include:

• Reviewing batch documentation and supporting product release

• Reviewing and approving deviations, change requests, trend reports and standard operating procedures

• Providing visible and proactive QA support on the shop floor

• Supporting timely resolution of quality-related issues

• Identifying trends, risks and improvement opportunities

• Simplifying and optimizing processes while maintaining compliance and product quality

• Supporting internal audits and inspections by health authorities, including presenting relevant quality data

You will work closely with colleagues across QA, production and supporting functions. Collaboration is therefore essential, and you should enjoy sharing knowledge, asking questions and developing solutions together with others.

Digitalization and AI are becoming increasingly important in our work. You will have the opportunity to contribute to how data, digital solutions and responsibly used AI-supported tools can strengthen trend identification, improve workflows and enable more effective quality oversight. Solutions must remain compliant, transparent and supported by sound professional judgement.

The position offers opportunities to develop your professional QA capabilities and your understanding of pharmaceutical production. We support individual development through feedback, knowledge sharing, increased responsibility and involvement in improvement activities and cross-functional initiatives.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a colleague who contributes both professionally and personally to the team. To succeed in the role, we expect that you:

• Hold a relevant academic degree, for example in pharmacy, veterinary medicine or a related natural science

• Have experience from the pharmaceutical industry, preferably including at least two years within quality assurance or production

• Have a strong quality mindset and can apply a risk-based approach to case handling

• Are motivated by simplification, optimization and continuous improvement

• Are curious about digital tools and the potential responsible use of AI within quality processes

• Are adaptable and able to maintain quality and overview when priorities change

• Take responsibility for your own learning and development

• Are willing to challenge existing ways of working constructively

• Are an inclusive and dedicated team player who builds trust and respect

• Have strong collaboration and communication skills

• Are proficient in written and spoken English

About the department

Our Quality Assurance department consists of 38 dedicated employees responsible for assuring the quality and compliance of API purification processes.

We work closely with production to ensure robust processes, reliable quality oversight and timely support to daily operations. At the same time, we continuously challenge ourselves to simplify, optimize and develop the way we work.

Our culture is built on teamwork, openness and mutual support. We value different perspectives and believe that strong results are achieved when employees are given opportunities to develop, take responsibility and contribute to improvements.

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasks
The position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies 
You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Regional Sales Director – Oticon Export

At Oticon Export, we believe sustainable growth is built on strong partnerships, mutual trust, and a deep understanding of people and businesses.

Through our global network of partners, we help bring life-changing hearing care solutions to people around the world. Every market is different, with its own opportunities, challenges, and level of maturity. We see these differences as opportunities to learn, collaborate, and create sustainable growth together.

As Regional Sales Director (RSD), you will play a key role in developing partner relationships, accelerating business performance, and supporting long-term market development across a diverse portfolio of countries.

Working closely with distributors and colleagues across the Demant organization, you will help shape the future of hearing care while creating value for partners, customers, and the people who rely on our solutions.

We are looking for a relationship-oriented sales leader who understands that growth is achieved through people. Someone who can identify opportunities behind market dynamics and recognize the strengths, motivations, and potential of individuals and organizations.

The role

As Regional Sales Director, you will be responsible for driving commercial success across an assigned portfolio of partner markets. Working closely with each partner, you will develop market strategies, identify growth opportunities, and ensure the successful implementation of Oticon's commercial initiatives.

A key part of the role is building trusted relationships across all levels of partner organizations and acting as a bridge between partners and the expertise available throughout Demant and Oticon Export.

You will help partners strengthen their commercial capabilities, leadership practices, and overall business performance, while ensuring initiatives are tailored to local market realities and cultural contexts.

We are a team of approximately 20 colleagues within Export Sales and work closely alongside three highly experienced Regional Sales Directors.

The position is based at Demant Headquarters in Smørum, Denmark. While the role involves significant international travel, we also place great importance on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and spending meaningful time with colleagues at headquarters.

Key responsibilities

• Build strong, long-term partnerships with distributors based on trust, transparency, and shared objectives.

• Identify commercial opportunities and co-create growth strategies with partners.

• Support partners in strengthening organizational capabilities, leadership practices, and commercial excellence.

• Challenge and inspire partners to elevate performance while respecting local market realities and cultural differences.

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Demant, including Oticon Export's functional experts, while building a strong network throughout the wider Demant Group.

• Share best practices across markets and foster a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.

• Act as a trusted ambassador of Oticon and the values that define our partnerships around the world.

Who you are

You bring curiosity, humility, and a long-term perspective to your work.

Building trust and creating meaningful connections come naturally to you, and you thrive in an international environment where relationships, cultural understanding, and collaboration are key to success.

You understand that every partner is unique. Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach, you adapt your style to different people, organizations, and situations. You know how to challenge constructively, support development, and help partners progress from where they are today to where they aspire to be tomorrow.

You combine strong commercial acumen with genuine interest in people, and you are motivated by helping others succeed with achieving sustainable business results.

Qualifications

• Experience working with distributors, indirect sales channels, or partner-led business models.

• Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering sustainable growth.

• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Experience working across cultures and diverse international markets.

• Fluent in English; proficiency in French would be considered an advantage.

Why join Oticon Export?

At Oticon Export, you will join a highly engaged international team committed to helping partners succeed and grow. We combine entrepreneurial thinking with the strength, expertise, and resources of the Demant Group.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence business performance across multiple international markets, collaborate with senior stakeholders, expand your global network, and contribute to bringing life-changing hearing care solutions to more people around the world.

Together, we create an environment where partners, customers, and colleagues thrive through strong partnerships, continuous development, and sustainable growth.

We look forward to welcoming you

Please submit your CV no later than November 12, 2026.

For questions about the position, please contact General Manager, Jakob Brøgger Kjærgaard at  jkbo@demant.com.

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions and expertise to help people hear better. From hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment, services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged across the hearing healthcare industry. Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
 Department of Food Science
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

  The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

   	
• Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing 	
• Food process system engineering 	
• Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools 	
• Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes. 	
• Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing     A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

   	
• A collaborative and innovative mindset 	
• Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work 	
• A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level 	
• Experience with international collaborations 	
• Ability to establish industrial collaboration 	
• Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills   Tenure-track assistant professor
 The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

  The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

  Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

  Associate professor

  Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
 
 The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
 General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here
 
 For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

  For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

  Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  The tenure-track assistant programme
 The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

  Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

  After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

  Salary and employment conditions
 The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing.  Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

  Filing of application
 The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

  The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including: 	 		
• Please describe and document international network and relations 		
• Please describe and document internationally based activities 		
• Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark 		
• Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media 		
• Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants. 	 	 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)    	
• Research plan - description of current and future research plans    	
• If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document: 	 		
• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students 		
• Teaching experience 		
• Formal pedagogical training 	 	    	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers   Applying for the associate professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding  	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)  	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans  	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.  

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.  

  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 

  211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

  211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.
